title: Negative vs Positive Feedback
text: Negative feedback opposes the initial change to maintain homeostasis. Positive feedback amplifies the initial change (rare in hormonal systems, e.g., oxytocin during childbirth).

title: Inhibition Pathway
text: High thyroxine inhibits TRH release, so less TSH is released, so less thyroxine is produced. The cycle continues until thyroxine drops to normal levels, when inhibition decreases.
